_comment: A walkthrough script shaped like the Opus drafts plain_variable_no_rerender__motion's run rejected on 2026-10-12 (4 attempts, step_by_step_walkthrough). The drafts were not saved, so this is rebuilt from the grader messages: the hook 'Why doesn't your counter change when you change the number?', chapter cards captioned as one 'Step one. Counter runs.', the running example 'let count = 0, inside Counter' said as 'let count equals zero', and chapter titles using 'you', 'notices' and 'resets'. Source: content/react_usestate_basics.md, main 7.2 + 7.4 (the reel's pool), supporting 7.1 + 7.3. Every motion grader must pass it: shorts/motion_walkthrough_agreement_test.py.
topic: Why does reassigning a plain local variable inside a component not change what the screen shows?
hook_question: Why doesn't your counter change when you change the number?

shots.speech: Why doesn't your counter change when you change the number? Nothing ever asks React to look.

captions.text: Why doesn't your counter change when you change the number?
Nothing ever asks React to look.

shots.visual: Navy field. KineticTitle 'WHY DOESN'T IT CHANGE?' builds word by word; a big counter sits at 0.

shots.speech: The missing step is called a re-render.

captions.text: The missing step is called a re-render.

shots.visual: Iris into the blue field. Kinetic title 'RE-RENDER' stamps in.

shots.speech: Let's follow one counter. Inside Counter, you write let count equals zero.

captions.text: Let's follow one counter.
Inside Counter, you write `let count = 0`.

shots.visual: Blue field, label 'FOLLOW ONE COUNTER'. Two chips: count 0 and screen 0.

captions.text: Step one. Counter runs.

shots.visual: Bar wipe into the paper field. ChapterCard 'STEP 1 OF 4', 'Counter runs'.

shots.speech: React runs Counter from the top. A brand new count is made, and the screen shows zero.

captions.text: React runs Counter from the top.
A brand new count is made, and the screen shows zero.

shots.visual: Paper field, step chip 01. Code window with the two lines; the count chip and the screen chip both read 0.

captions.text: Step two. You click.

shots.visual: Iris into the navy field. ChapterCard 'STEP 2 OF 4', 'You click, count goes up'.

shots.speech: Your click handler runs count equals count plus one. In memory, count really is one now.

captions.text: Your click handler runs `count = count + 1`.
In memory, count really is one now.

shots.visual: Navy field. The count chip flips from 0 to 1; the screen chip stays at 0.

captions.text: Step three. Nobody notices.

shots.visual: Stack rise into the blue field. ChapterCard 'STEP 3 OF 4', 'Nobody notices the change'.

shots.speech: Nothing observes that change. Nothing tells React a re-render is needed, so the screen still shows zero.

captions.text: Nothing observes that change.
Nothing tells React a re-render is needed, so the screen still shows zero.

shots.visual: Blue field. A NO tag over React; the screen chip stays at 0 while count reads 1.

captions.text: Step four. Next render.

shots.visual: Diagonal stripes into the yellow field. ChapterCard 'STEP 4 OF 4', 'The next render resets it'.

shots.speech: Even if React ran Counter again, it would throw the old count away. It starts back at zero.

captions.text: Even if React ran Counter again, it would throw the old count away.
It starts back at zero.

shots.visual: Yellow field. The count chip crumbles; a new count chip drops in at 0.

shots.speech: So count went up for a moment. The screen stayed at zero the whole time.

captions.text: So count went up for a moment.
The screen stayed at zero the whole time.

shots.visual: Blue field. Big counter shows 0; a ghost 1 fades beside it.

shots.speech: So a changed value is not a re-render. Something has to tell React to run again.

captions.text: So a changed value is not a re-render.
Something has to tell React to run again.

shots.visual: Blue field. KineticTitle 'A CHANGED VALUE IS NOT A RE-RENDER'.

shots.speech: Re-render in four steps: Counter runs, you click, nobody notices, the next render resets.

captions.text: Re-render in four steps: Counter runs, you click, nobody notices, the next render resets.

shots.visual: Stack rise into the navy field. RecapGrid with the four steps.

shots.speech: Follow for more, one idea at a time.

captions.text: Follow for more, one idea at a time.

shots.visual: Navy field. End card: Up next, Follow button.
